description: Resolve a marine species or genus name to its WoRMS AphiaID, accepted name, authority, status (accepted/unaccepted), rank, and high-level classification (kingdom/family/genus). WoRMS is the authoritative world register of marine species. Keyless.

marine_only.description: Restrict to marine taxa. Default true.

name.description: Scientific name to look up, e.g. "Orcinus orca" or "Octopus".

title: Worms Search Species
